source: Captured GitHub Actions logs from Medsol AI Marketing OS PRs #1 and #2; command strings are reproduction guidance, not reenacted logs.

cases.observed: Argument of type 'string | undefined' is not assignable to parameter of type 'string'.
cases.resolution: Validate and narrow optional path before use; action ?? ''.
Use an explicit non-null check or optional access and assert the test result.

cases.observed: The 'import.meta' meta-property is not allowed in files which will build into CommonJS output.
cases.resolution: Resolve fixtures from the package cwd rather than import.meta.

cases.observed: Initial scan: 2 critical, 2 high, 3 moderate vulnerabilities.
cases.resolution: Refresh dependencies; inspect SBOM and scan artifact, track remaining severity, apply approved exceptions only.

cases.observed: Prisma P2003 on deleting a disposable Organization: incident-response scanner in another integration test processed a shared tenant and emitted an OutboxEvent after cleanup; cross-test DB interference.
cases.resolution: Isolate incident scanner integration fixtures to their own disposable tenant, preserve global production scan behavior, and rerun all PostgreSQL tests together.
